dedupe_keys.name: large scale synthetic dataset and machine learning benchmark for fault localization in distribution systems

description: Large-scale Synthetic Dataset and Machine Learning Benchmark for Fault Localization in Distribution Systems is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Zhonghe Chen, Deepak Ajwani (University College Dublin). This dataset provides a large-scale collection of synthetic fault scenarios for machine-learning-based fault localization in electrical distribution systems. The data were generated using OpenDSS and contain 81,646 scenarios across nine distribution feeders derived from IEEE, EPRI, and DISCO test systems, ranging from small networks to feeders with more than 6,000 nodes. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
